editorial.blurb: North Pond elevates special occasions with stunning lakefront views, impeccable service, and beautifully executed French-American cuisine in a sophisticated yet warm setting.
editorial.insiderTip: Book the dinner tasting menu ($136/person) and arrive via rideshare (2600 North Lakeview Ave) to avoid parking stress—the staff will personalize your experience, from custom menus to special touches like beeswax candles and truffles.
signatureDishes: Brown sugar pork belly with smoked apple butter and mushrooms
